about: Worked-muscle marks for the exercise drawings (scripts/build-exercise-frames.py). Per drawing and frame, a list of [areas, x1, y1, x2, y2, width]: the numbered areas between the drawn lines (see the script's --sheets output), cut to a band from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) that wide, in the drawing's 512 x 512 pixels. An empty area list means the whole body inside the band.
